notes.title: VR Patch 1.01 is live! (Added a VR Launcher).
notes.content:
A lot of people have noticed we were not under the "VR" section of their games library. That is because we had a "Non-VR" Launcher that had options to launch VR or play in Non-VR mode.

To fix this problem, we created a "VR" launcher as well so you can choose your options in or out of VR.

We also did a couple other minor changes/bug fixes.

Special shout out to Marcus who first brought this to our attention!

-The VReleased Team
